doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: How McNeil got into music
summary: His musical family led him to take trumpet lessons.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: 1916, I see. So you're considerably younger than Bailey. Fair much so, yeah. Uh, and how did you happen to get interested in music? Did you hear any music around when you were a kid?

Well my father was a musician and uh, he played music through the years. As a matter of fact my family, you know, all were musically inclined and practically everybody in the family played some type of musical instrument. And actually when I grew up I sort of became a part of me.

And so I started taking lessons, you know, to learn how to play the trumpet. Of course my family was string musicians. My daddy was a piano player and mostly any strings instrument he could master. It was pretty good.
